jobs.description:
Are you passionate about supply chain planning within a End-2-End perspective and motivated by making operational decisions that create value across the entire value chain? Do you thrive in a collaborative environment where customer focus, stakeholder management and data-driven decision-making go hand in hand? Then this could be the opportunity for you. We are looking for an Operational Network Planner for CBP Rødkærsbro cluster.

The position is based at our HQ Viby J, but expect visits to our sites in Rødkærsbro and Branderup.

“As part of the team, you will help plan the supply of mozzarella and pizza topping products for customers around the world, working closely with stakeholders across Supply Chain, Commercial and Production. If you are motivated by operational planning and making an impact in a global supply chain, you could be the candidate we’re looking for.” says Susanne Grundt Gotfredsen, Supply Chain Network Planning Manager.

Read more about Supply Chain at Arla here Inside Arla.

How you will make an impact

As an Operational Network Planner, you will play a key role within the Sales & Operations Execution (S&OE) horizon, ensuring that we deliver excellent service levels to customers while balancing production capacity, inventory levels and waste reduction across markets and warehouses.

You will join a highly collaborative planning team consisting of four Site Schedulers, two Operational Network Planners and one Component Planner, supporting two production sites. Working closely with colleagues across Supply Chain, Commercial and Production, you will help drive operational decisions that create value across the end-to-end supply chain.

Your key responsibilities will include

• Optimizing supply chain performance through root cause analysis and data-driven decisions.

• Monitoring relevant KPIs and implementing corrective actions to achieve targets.

• Conducting scenario planning to mitigate availability risks, reduce waste, and assess the impact of demand fluctuations on finished goods.

• Escalating unresolved short-term imbalances to global or local S&OE executive forums and key stakeholders.

• Leading proactive dialogue between Supply Chain and Commercial teams to solve complex issues.

• Identifying and contributing to optimization initiatives from an end-to-end perspective.

What will make you successful

You are an ambitious and structured professional with strong analytical skills and the ability to work across multiple functions. You thrive on collaboration and have a natural ability to engage with stakeholders from across the business.

You are motivated by change and actively contribute to the continuous improvement of ways of working and collaboration.

We imagine you

• Hold a relevant Bachelor's or Master's degree within Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Engineering, Business or a related field.

• Have 2-5 years of experience within supply chain planning, logistics or manufacturing, preferably working within S&OE or short-term planning horizons.

• Are comfortable analysing data and using insights to support operational decisions.

• Communicate clearly and confidently with stakeholders across different functions and organisational levels.

• Are curious, proactive and motivated by continuous improvement and optimisation.

What do we offer?

An inclusive corporate culture that creates job satisfaction is important to us, and we prioritize giving our employees good development opportunities. We are looking for you who want to grow with us at Arla Foods!

Arla Foods has a collective agreement and always offers good and competitive working conditions. In addition, we have a high priority on safety and the working environment.

About Arla

We are Arla – a European dairy cooperative with over 19,000 employees and around 8,600 farmers. Our cooperative model creates a unique closeness to our farmers – the owners of Arla – and motivates us every day to deliver the very best for our farmers, colleagues, our milk, our consumers, and our environment.

Would you like to join us?

Please apply as soon as possible. We process applications on a continuous basis and close the position once the right candidate has been found.

If you have any questions, please contact Supply Chain Network Planning Manager, Susanne Grundt Gotfredsen at +45 91 31 40 19.

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

jobs.occupation: Technical Project Lead - SCADA Systems M/F
jobs.description:
Do you want to become our Technical Project Lead within global wind turbine projects – and contribute to a greener world?

Come join a leading supplier of electromechanical systems and become a key part of our further success.

This is the perfect job for you if you want to work with cutting edge technologies and work with the leading wind power companies in the world.

Purpose of position:

We enable a wind powered future

At our office in Hammel, you will join our core project team, responsible for new customer projects. Here, you will work alongside our key account managers, project managers and our highly competent team of engineers and technicians. You will be deeply involved in both the project execution and bidding process.

Drive technical challenging projects

As our new technical project lead you will be anchor point for customer software pre-configuration of SCADA cabinets across a wide range of applications and configurations. This position requires expertise in networking and SCADA systems to ensure secure, reliable connectivity and seamless integration between industrial control systems and IT infrastructure.

Responsibilities

• 
Acting as software product owner for customer pre-configuration solutions

• 
Serving as the customer's technical point of contact regarding software releases and software-related topics.

• 
Collaborating closely with the project team to deliver customer solutions and supporting the production line with software-related inquiries.

• 
Performing hands-on installation and deployment of SCADA software packages on industrial PCs and servers in collaboration with Automation Engineers.

• 
Configuring system parameters, communication protocols and security settings.

• 
Create and maintain accurate documentation of configuration steps and system readiness checks according to corporate documentation standards.

• 
Support the creation of customer documentation related to SCADA and automation.

Our Requirements

Grow with us

Our workplace oozes of the same type of energy we fuel – fresh, innovative and sustainable. Likewise, the growth we experience as a company reflects our investment in employee development, and you will get plenty of opportunity to impact your future with us.

Skilled Technical Project Lead

As a person, you thrive in a can-do culture, where we constantly strive to exceed our customers’ expectations. You are self-driven, able to take the lead and drive your projects independently. Moreover, you:

• 
Have +5 years’ experience with software/automation for industrial control panels or similar.

• 
Have solid experience from a role as a Technical Project Lead

• 
Bring a BSc in Automation, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, IT, Software Development, Computer Science, or a related field.

• 
Have the flexibility to travel around 20 days a year to visit customers and our production sites – mostly within Europe

• 
Speak and write English fluently

H+H International A/S is a company listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen, headquartered in Copenhagen, and one of Europe’s leading producers of wall building materials. Founded in 1909, the H+H Group today operates 27 factories across Northern and Central Europe and produced 2.7 million cubic meters of autoclaved aerated concrete and calcium silicate units in 2024. In Germany, H+H is the owner or majority shareholder of 8 plants manufacturing autoclaved aerated concrete and calcium silicate units; the CWE-Region generates a combined annual turnover of more than 200 million euros and employs approximately 350 people. The Danish Office is located in Aarhus.

**Head of Sales, Nordic – based in Denmark

**

Sales oriented and analytically strong leader – with a deep understanding of the construction-/building material industry

Do you want to lead sales in a company that’s shaping the future of the construction industry? You will be responsible for the development and growth of H+H’s commercial activities in Denmark, with additional responsibility for our smaller, growing markets in Sweden and Finland – both on an operational and strategic level. You’ll own the regional sales plan, develop the markets, and lead a high-performing team, with a clear focus on performance, customer relationships, and growth in a demanding market that offers real opportunity to make your mark.

Key Responsibilities

• Revenue Ownership: Full ownership of revenue and sales targets across Denmark, Sweden and Finland.

• Team Leadership: Leading, building and developing a high-performing organisation across the Nordic markets. This includes recruit, train, motivate and coach, drive proactive, cooperative ways of working across Sales, Calculation, Technical support etc.

• Lead & develop the team Recruit, train, motivate and coach to high performance; drive proactive, cooperative ways of working.

• Key Account Management: Strengthening relationships with key customers: developers, architects, and general contractors.

• Market Development/Customer Excellence: Build and grow H+H’s position in Sweden and Finland while continuing to strengthen the core Danish market; monitoring trends and competitors across the region.

• Pricing & Commercial Models: Developing pricing strategies and commercial models tailored to each market.

• Cross-border Collaboration: Close collaboration with the delivering plant in northern Germany.

• Internal Networking: Active networking across H+H International, with particular ties to the leadership team in Region Central Western Europe.

• Digital Sales: Active use of digital sales tools and data-driven decision making.

Your Profile

• Experience: B2B sales experience at senior level, ideally in the construction or building materials industry, with exposure to Nordic markets.

• Leadership: Proven leadership experience with accountability for sales results across multiple markets.

• Communication: Strong communication skills and the ability to build trusted, long-term relationships across cultures.

• Languages: Fluency in Danish and English

• Personal skills: Driven, curious, emphatic, result oriented and analytical

• Digital Mindset: Familiarity with CRM systems and data-driven sales approaches.

• AI & Innovation: Openness to digitalization and AI-supported ways of working.

What We Offer

• Impact & Autonomy: A key role with a high degree of autonomy and real influence across three markets.

• Team & Culture: Ambitious colleagues within a company in transformation.

• Attractive Package: Competitive base salary and performance-based compensation.

• Room to Grow: The opportunity to be a part of shaping the future of H+H’s Nordic sales organisation.

How to apply

The application and selection process will be done in collaboration with Brinch & Partners. If you would like to know more about H+H and this opportunity, please feel free to contact Partner Jens Christian Jensen by telephone +45 2784 7405 or by email jc@brinchpartners.dk.

In order to apply for the job, use the “Apply for the job” option above. We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We will invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, but not during the summer holiday.

H+H International A/S has roots dating back to 1909 and is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen. Today, the Group operates 27 factories across Northern and Central Europe, producing 2.7 million cubic meters of wall building materials in 2024 alone. Across our markets, we work to build with ease – and we are looking for someone who wants to help shape that future across Denmark, Sweden, and Finland.

jobs.occupation: Senior Hydraulic Engineer - Heavy Industry Brake Systems
jobs.description:
Senior Hydraulic Engineer (Team Lead) – Heavy Industry Brake Systems

Location: Vejstrup, Denmark · Department: Engineering

Are you ready to lead innovation in hydraulic systems? Join the global leader in braking solutions and help shape high‑performance systems for wind, oil & gas, mining, and other demanding sectors. This is a hands‑on leadership role where you combine sound engineering judgment with practical execution—collaborating across teams and engaging directly with customers and suppliers.

Your impact

• Lead end‑to‑end hydraulic design and development for next‑generation brake systems.

• Translate customer needs into robust technical solutions that meet global standards and deliver measurable performance.

• Strengthen knowledge sharing and standardization to improve quality, speed, and efficiency across projects.

What you’ll do

• Serve as the subject‑matter expert for hydraulic systems—owning architecture, design calculations, and component selection.

• Prepare technical layouts, schematics, and proposals to support Sales and Marketing.

• Provide technical and commercial support (cost estimates, business cases) for bidding activities.

• Plan and execute system testing, inspection, and validation to ensure reliability and safety.

• Lead root‑cause analyses and support quality claims and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Act as technical liaison with customers and suppliers throughout project execution, including site visits.

• Drive development projects that advance our brake solutions and set new benchmarks.

• Capture, structure, and standardize technical knowledge to enhance processes and tools.

What you bring

• Experience: Solid background in hydraulic engineering within wind, oil & gas, mining, marine, or similar heavy industries (typically 10+ years; we welcome capable candidates with equivalent experience and growth potential).

• Skills: Strong theoretical foundation paired with practical, hands‑on problem solving.

• Tools & systems: Proficiency with MS Office; experience with ERP systems (we use AXAPTA, other platforms are welcome).

• Ways of working: Familiarity with stage‑gate project models; experience with Wrike or similar tools is an advantage.

• Mindset: Organized, proactive, and collaborative—able to work independently while enabling the team.

• Quality & safety: Experience in ISO‑certified environments and a safety‑first approach.

• Language & travel: Fluent in English (spoken and written); Danish is a plus. Willing to travel ~30 days per year.

Why join us

• Work on innovative, high‑impact projects shaping the future of hydraulic brake systems.

• Be part of a supportive, collaborative culture that values sharing knowledge and continuous improvement.

• Great opportunities for personal and professional growth through learning, mentoring, and responsibility.

• Competitive compensation and benefits: salary, pension plan, health insurance, and a great lunch program.

• A dynamic role with flexibility and diverse tasks—where your ideas can make a real difference.

Inclusion & equal opportunity

We value different perspectives and welcome applicants with varied career paths. If you’re excited about the role but don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply—your potential matters.

Want to know more?

Reach out to Technical Manager, Nikolaj Pave at +45 63 255 255 for more information.

Ready to apply?

Apply now and share your vision for the future of hydraulics, via the following link as soon as possible.

Learn more at www.svendborg-brakes.com.

Svendborg Brakes creates high growth for both customers and us by innovating, testing and delivering world-class braking solutions. We are value driven and customer focused, and we continuously strive for superior and unmatched quality in design, products, testing, certification and services. This makes us Global Leading Experts and the preferred and trusted provider in the field of intelligent braking solutions. Part of the Regal Rexnord Group www.regalrexnord.com.

If you want to hear more about the position, please feel free to contact

Nikolaj Pave

A Snapshot of Your Day

The Commercial Sales Manager is responsible for optimizing the financial and commercial outcome of projects and takes the active role of negotiating the commercial parts of Offshore Service contracts. o you want to be part of an industry that is striving to protect our planet from further damage? Are you one who looks for solutions and regards a problem as an opportunity? Are you a person who believes in getting things done right the first time? If yes, we are looking for an enthusiastic Commercial Sales Manager to join our dedicated Offshore Service Sales team. The role provides an opportunity to operate in a dynamic department working on some of the biggest, most complex renewable energy projects in the world; negotiating with customers the financial and commercial outcome of projects, putting together compelling offers, presenting to management and internal stakeholders and ultimately working collaboratively with our customers to grow the wind industry.

How You'll Make an Impact

• 
You will be integral to the sales process for our wind turbine and service contract offerings for the offshore wind sector.

• 
You will be working, as part of team, to deliver deals shaped to represent the commercial interests of both our customers and the business.

Leading commercial evaluation of risks and opportunities facing your projects,

• 
Understanding and demonstrating impact of changes on customer business cases for energy projects,

• 
Preparation and presentation of project specific sales forecasts and budgets to high-level management,

• 
Working with the commercial team to establish and implement efficient processes and best practices.

What You Bring

• 
A passion for renewable energy and a sense of the importance to lead the change,

• 
Knowledge of customer business case, preferably for energy projects,

• 
Demonstrable commercial contract management skills including in commercial negotiations, preferably within sales and/or the energy or construction sector,

• 
Good interpersonal skills with ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment and the ability to multi-task to meet deadlines,

• 
An ability to communicate technically complicated topics concisely to high-level management and customers in a high-pressure environment,

• 
A good knowledge of cost calculation approaches, finance methods, and commercial financial topics (bonds, escalation, currency, indemnities, liabilities, etc.),

• 
Project management skills,

• 
Fluency in English, both orally and in writing, International experience and willingness to travel (25%) and work in a global environment,

• 
Qualified applicants must be legally authorized to work in the country of employment (no work authorization sponsoring now or in the future),

• 
A degree, preferably in business admin, finance or law.

 About the Team

We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

celebrates character—no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or

differences.

Rewards/Benefits

Here are examples of the rewards and benefits Siemens Energy offers:

Opportunities to work with a global team

Medical benefits

Job Description

Do you thrive in designing and developing software solutions for modular robotics platforms? Are you motivated by taking responsibility for the entire software development process and ensuring compliance with quality and architectural standards?
If so, we might have the right job for you!

As a Software Engineer within vision and robotics, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining software solutions while ensuring compliance with quality and architectural standards. Moreover, you will contribute to the successful implementation of solutions by conducting training sessions for internal stakeholders and end users. You will support projects, collaborate closely with the Technical Product Owner (TPO), and ensure valuable feedback from projects and site integration is used for adjustments and further development.

Responsibility for Vision and Robotics
We are a global organization, but you will be working from our office in Aarhus and be part of a small team of highly skilled colleagues in logistics. You will join the Robot Product Team, which covers multiple disciplines – Electrical, Mechanical, Automation – with you as the software responsible. You will work in close collaboration with the TPO, who acts as Product Owner, and you will have sparring opportunities with software colleagues across the organization to support knowledge sharing and development. Here, your responsibilities will be:

• 
Improving new software products related to vision and robotic applications and supporting their use in projects.

• 
Maintaining and developing software applications according to our operating model and applicable standards.

• 
Ensuring code quality through reviews, documentation, and adherence to coding and architectural guidelines.

• 
Offering input to automation strategy and technical requirements and setting product requirements in collaboration with the business.

• 
Testing and validating functionalities on our local test loop or on sites.

• 
Collaborating with interdisciplinary teams on a common system and evaluating and selecting appropriate technologies for automation and system integration.

Experienced Software Developer
You are familiar with commonly used tools, frameworks, and libraries relevant to 3D vision, point cloud processing, and AI development, and can evaluate and apply them effectively based on product needs. Additionally, we imagine that:

• 
You hold a bachelor's or master's degree, or an equivalent qualification in computer science, engineering, or a related field.

• 
You have solid proficiency developing real-time applications in C# and Python.

• 
You possess solid expertise in classical computer vision and 3D geometry, with a strong focus on point cloud processing and object recognition.

• 
Experience or interest in machine learning and signal processing is highly relevant, as these fields play an increasing role in advancing vision and robotics applications.

• 
You have experience in developing and maintaining various software architectures such as Docker and Kubernetes.

• 
You possess strong knowledge of software design principles, design patterns, and effort estimation for development tasks, and have hands-on experience with version control systems (e.g., Git), as well as software prototyping and conceptualization.

• 
You bring a solid understanding of high-level integration with robotic systems and can design and implement interfaces that enable effective communication between software components and robotic controls.

• 
You can combine input from multiple sensors into valuable insights. This could be cameras, LiDAR's, encoders, safety sensors etc.

Moreover, you demonstrate innovative thinking, analytical skills, and a strong problem-solving mindset. You bring excellent communication skills, team spirit, and a high willingness to learn. You enjoy working collaboratively across disciplines in a diverse and inclusive environment.

Interested?
If you find the description interesting, please do not hesitate to contact Henning Horn Lauritsen +45 8741 4674 with any question you might have or apply via the link.
We look very much forward to hearing from you!

BEUMER Group
Conveying, loading, palletizing, packing, sortation, and distribution – BEUMER Group is a leader within the development and manufacture of high-technological intralogistics systems for global markets. Our employees stand out from others thanks to their ability to supply innovative solutions to our customers. They can do this because they know the industry and are passionate about continuously developing and expanding their knowledge. We support these high standards through teamwork, mutual respect and a working culture based on trust that fosters stability and security for all our employees. Our common goal is to implement outstanding and innovative projects worldwide.

WHAT BENEFITS DO WE OFFER?

• 
We offer exciting opportunities in an internationally operating family-owned company with locations in more than 70 countries – including the opportunity to temporarily work from one of our international locations as part of our Flex Abroad Program.

• 
During our immersive onboarding program in, you will receive an extensive overview of BEUMER Group, our history, and our vision for the future, whilst also getting to know your new colleagues.

• 
Through a culture of open feedback, transparent corporate updates, and regular employee events, we actively cultivate a friendly, open, and collaborative working environment

• 
Your personal and professional growth is integral to our ethos. We champion your development through a wide range of training courses and upskilling opportunities — including support for external courses and grants for trainees.

• 
Flexible working hours and the choice of operating from a remote office are important components of our modern work culture, much like our bright, spacious offices and ergonomically optimized workstations.

• 
Your health matters to us. Enjoy free access to our on-site fitness centre and join one of our many sports clubs for a healthier, more connected work-life. We also provide computer glasses subsidies, vegetarian lunch options, and free fresh fruit to help boost your well-being.

• 
You will get access to Denmark’s largest discount portal, and receive exclusive discounts and promotional offers from a wide-range of companies and businesses.

• 
From accident insurance to attractive company pension schemes and health insurance for you and your children, we are committed to supporting your long-term well-being.

• 
Supporting you when you are not in work is also important to us. Our Staff Association organizes and sponsors social, cultural, and sporting activities, including our annual Christmas and Summer parties, which are always great fun.

• 
Sustainability is one of our key core values, which we tackle on multiple fronts. For example, you will have access to our electric charging stations in the employee parking area, with the electricity being provided at cost price.

• 
Fair pay is extended to all our employees, and we ensure we provide a balanced and equitable remuneration framework. You will also receive a number of additional salary benefits that combine to form an attractive salary package.

• 
Everyone needs a rest and a break from work at some point. That is why you will receive 30 days of vacation days per year, as well as various other special holiday days. We also provide extra support for maternity and paternity leave.

jobs.occupation: Senior Software Engineer — Node.js / Serverless Cloud & API Integrations
jobs.description:
Vi søger ildsjæle

Senior Software Engineer — Node.js / Serverless Cloud & API Integrations

Do you want to help shape a modern, scalable HR platform used by organisations worldwide?

At HR-ON we’re looking for a Senior Backend Software Engineer who enjoys building cloud-native services, optimising data workflows, and—yes—crafting solid API integrations … but treats these as just one part of a varied engineering role.

What You’ll Do

• Design and build core backend services in Node.js & TypeScript running on AWS serverless infrastructure (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, etc.).

• Model and optimise data in PostgreSQL and MariaDB, ensuring performance and reliability at scale.

• Develop and maintain GraphQL & REST endpoints that power our own product features and partner integrations.

• Evolve the platform architecture for resilience, observability, and easy maintenance.

• Automate CI/CD pipelines with GitLab and champion clean-code practices through code reviews and pair-programming.

• Collaborate with product, frontend, and DevOps peers to deliver end-to-end features that delight our users.

API and third-party integrations remain important, but they sit alongside core service development, data engineering, and architectural work.

About You

You’re an experienced engineer who:

• Writes production-grade Node.js/TypeScript and understands modern serverless patterns.

• Knows your way around SQL—from schema design to complex query optimisation.

• Has built GraphQL or REST services and integrated external systems, even if integrations aren’t your sole focus.

• Uses GitLab (or similar) for version control, CI, and automated tests.

• Thinks in terms of scalable, maintainable architecture and values knowledge-sharing with teammates.

Bonus Points

• AWS infrastructure-as-code (CDK, Terraform, CloudFormation).

• Bash/Zsh scripting on *nix systems.

• A fondness for type-safe, declarative coding styles (e.g. fp-inspired TypeScript).

We don’t expect you to tick every box—curiosity and a growth mindset matter most.

Why HR-ON

• High autonomy & influence over tech choices and ways of working.

• Value-based self-management—trust, transparency, and flexibility come first.

• Central Odense office with remote options; we still value regular in-person collaboration.

• 50 passionate colleagues across Denmark, Germany, Norway, and Japan, united by a flat structure and meaningful work.

How to Apply

We assess applications continuously - apply online today, ideally with code samples or project links.

Questions?

• Ali E. Cevik, CEO: +45 71 99 07 65 | ali.cevik@hr-on.com

We look forward to hearing from you!

Work location : Odense C

Application deadline : As soon as possible

At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high-growth FTSE-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust!

As AI reshapes how consumers search, discover, and choose brands, Trustpilot’s unique dataset of authentic human sentiment is becoming increasingly critical. We are uniquely positioned to define how trust and reputation function in an AI-driven digital economy and we’re building an inclusive environment where curious, ambitious people can do the best work of their careers. To support Trustpilot’s rapid expansion, we’re looking for a Student Assistant to join our Nordic Sales Team in Copenhagen.

With us you’ll have the opportunity to try new things and figure out where you want to take your career. We hope we’ve grabbed your attention so far, please keep on reading for more details about the role.

What you’ll be doing:

In this role you will be supporting the sales team with both low and high tasks such as:

• Research and identify potential leads

• Use lead generation tools to gather contact information

• Qualify leads based on specific criteria

• Maintain accurate lead records in the CRM system

• Collaborate with the sales team for correct lead handoff and knowledge sharing

• Coordinate customer-facing materials, including documents, presentations, design and other sales collateral

• Support event planning and coordination, including lead management before and after events, and run email cadences and outreach activities on behalf of the sales team

We’d like you to be able to work approximately 10-20 hours per week, but we are of course flexible depending on what your study schedule looks like.

Who you are:

• You have a positive, proactive mindset and are eager to learn

• You’re interested in commercial organizations and how they operate

• You have a strong motivation for sales and business development

• You can work independently, take ownership of tasks, and meet deadlines

• You have fluent communication skills in English, and fluency in both Danish and Swedish is a major plus. However, proficiency in at least one Nordic language is required.

• You have good understanding of Google and Microsoft products

And don’t worry if you don’t tick all the boxes (yet), we’ll get there. As a team we’ll ensure that you have the necessary support to build the skills you need along the way!

What’s in it for you:

• An opportunity to work and learn alongside supportive, talented, and passionate people in an international, fast-paced company

• Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company-wide celebrations and events, ERG activities, and team socials

• Opportunity to join the Trustpilot Social Club for a small monthly fee and attend regular social and leisure activities like go-karting, cooking classes, and escape rooms

• Employee discounts to restaurants and shops

• Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy, LinkedIn Learning, and Blinkist

• An international, collaborative office where different perspectives, ideas and languages come together - creating an environment where you can learn, challenge yourself and help shape what’s next

We are:

• Enthusiastic about what we do. Our sales teams are super collaborative and it’s a fun place to work if you enjoy seeing your hard work recognised and rewarded.

• Our culture is fast-paced and our employees grow as we do. You’ll have plenty of personal development opportunities thanks to our in-house enablement team and individual career mapping.

• Ideas people. We like our employees to be creative and always advocate for new ways of working

Still not sure?

We are Open to All, which means we want everyone to feel like they can see themselves at Trustpilot. We're keen to hear about your experiences as well as how you can help to create a fantastic culture for our amazing Trusties. So, don't worry if you're looking at this job description and feel like you don't meet all the requirements, we'd still really like to hear from you!

Keen to join us? Then please apply with your CV and Cover Letter in English as soon as possible.

A Snapshot of Your Day

This Specialist Professional role is a critical replacement to ensure business continuity within the Power and Grid Management team. The position is essential for maintaining agreed-upon delivery schedules and upholding the quality standards for our power plant control systems. To achieve these objectives, the role focuses on three core areas: advanced test strategy and planning, comprehensive test execution and automation, and rigorous defect management and analysis. These activities ensure that our digital products and solutions for the energy sector are robust, reliable, and meet all technical specifications before deployment. Given the focus on complex system verification, the ideal candidate will be a subject matter expert with extensive experience in verification engineering. This includes proven proficiency in test automation, scripting languages, and a deep understanding of the engineering design process, coupled with the ability to manage large projects and mentor junior professionals.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Analyze complex technical requirements and system designs for power and grid management solutions to define comprehensive verification strategies.

• Design, develop, and maintain robust test plans, test cases, and test procedures for new and existing product features.

• Act as a subject matter expert, managing large-scale test projects and processes with limited oversight.

• Coach, review, and delegate test development work to lower-level professionals, ensuring adherence to quality standards.

• Execute advanced manual and automated tests to validate functional requirements, benchmark system performance, and ensure product reliability.

• Develop, implement, and maintain sophisticated test automation frameworks and scripts using Python, Tcl, or other relevant languages.

• Establish and manage complex test environments, including system simulations and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) setups.

• Integrate automated testing into the CI/CD pipeline to enhance development workflow efficiency and feedback cycles.

• Identify, document, and meticulously track software defects and system anomalies through to resolution using workflow management tools.

• Conduct in-depth root cause analysis for difficult and complex problems, collaborating with development teams to find effective solutions.

• Generate detailed test summary reports and quality metrics to communicate findings and system readiness to stakeholders.

What You Bring

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Extensive experience, around 10 years, as a subject matter expert in verification engineering, software testing, or a similar role.

• Proven experience managing complex test projects or processes and mentoring other professionals.

• Demonstrated expertise in test automation, scripting, and testing complex software and hardware systems.

• Technical expertise in test automation, Python programming, scripting, Linux environments, simulations, and firmware development to support the design, testing, automation, and optimization of reliable and high‑quality technology solutions.

• Ability to apply Generative AI tools to improve test design, accelerate test procedure creation, enhance automation development, and increase overall testing efficiency and coverage.

• Expertise in quality and process management, including test planning, quality assurance, engineering design processes, and workflow management to ensure efficient execution, high‑quality deliverables, and continuous improvement across engineering and development activities.

• Strong behavioral abilities, including troubleshooting and problem‑solving, analytical thinking, and influencing skills to support effective decision-making, stakeholder engagement, and the successful resolution of complex challenges.

Can you own the platform and pipelines that EIVA’s software is built on?

EIVA is an equipment and software engineering company delivering solutions to the international maritime industry. Our customers operate within renewable energy, oil & gas exploration, seabed-to-surface construction and hydrographic surveying – often in demanding environments where timing, precision and safety margins matter.

You do not need to know the subsea domain to apply. Here, your product is the software itself, and your users are the other engineering teams who build and ship on the platform you own. What matters is curiosity – the ability to ask the right questions and translate what you hear into good technical decisions – and a collaborative, team-first mindset.

The position is based at EIVA’s Danish office in Stilling (just one minute from the E45, approximately 15 minutes from Aarhus by car and easily accessible by bus).

What's involved?

As Tech Lead – Infrastructure, you'll own the platform, pipelines and infrastructure that our NaviSuite software is built on.

Around 80% of the role is hands-on: working directly in the team's technical domains – platform, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, environments and tooling. The rest is technical leadership – owning architecture within the Infrastructure team, making the final call on anything inside the team's decision domain, and knowing when a question needs to go further, to our architects or to alignment with other teams. You'll also help keep that decision domain itself well defined: what the team can decide on its own, and where it needs external alignment.

There could be occasional travel – around one to two short trips a year.

Your responsibilities…

• Doing hands-on development and engineering work across the team's core technical domains – platform, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, environments and internal tooling (around 80% of the role)

• Making the final technical decisions within the team's decision domain, and helping define where that domain's boundaries sit versus where the team needs external alignment

• Securing technical quality in the team – code and infrastructure-as-code review, best practices, testing and automation standards

• Owning architecture in the team – ensuring platform and pipeline work aligns with EIVA's overall architecture, and explaining the interdependencies to the team

• Participating in refinement, securing that features, stories and tasks describe architectural dependencies, feasibility, quality requirements and operational aspects such as reliability, security, cost and developer experience

• Cross team alignment – representing the Infrastructure team's technical position and making sure its work fits with adjacent work elsewhere in the organisation

• Driving clarification with architects on technical questions that sit outside the team's decision domain

Also part of the role…

• Providing technical mentoring and sparring for the team's engineers

• Supporting the other development teams as users of the platform – helping with adoption, guidance and acting on their feedback

• Taking operational responsibility for the platform and pipelines

• Keeping the team's technical practices current – seeking out training, evaluating new tooling and sharing that knowledge internally

• Maintaining technical documentation for the platform, pipelines and environments

• Giving technical input to hiring and onboarding new engineers on the team

• Giving technical input to estimation and planning together with the Team Manager/Product Owner

The ideal candidate…

• Has a background in software engineering or computer science

• Has hands-on experience building and maintaining platforms, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code and internal tooling

• Has experience managing complex DevOps systems and workflows, and is comfortable making final technical calls within a defined decision domain

• Is familiar with tools such as Git/GitHub, artifact storage, Ansible and Terraform

• Has a collaborative mindset – comfortable gathering feedback from stakeholders across teams and using it to design clean, well-reasoned solutions

• Is a team player who's good at knowledge-sharing and educating peers, and takes proactive ownership of their domain

• It's a bonus if you also have experience with licence management systems, but not a requirement.

Joining the EIVA crew

At EIVA, you'll join a team that values openness, informality and collaboration – while working with high-end, innovative technology in an inspiring environment. We appreciate personal responsibility and proactivity, and there is room to make your mark if you spot new opportunities. Work-life balance matters to us and is reflected in the 15th, 20th and even 25th work anniversaries commonly celebrated at EIVA. We offer…

• A pension scheme and health insurance

• A canteen that no one leaves hungry

• An active social calendar

ROLE DESCRIPTION

INVISIO is looking for a commercially minded and pragmatic Corporate Legal Counsel to support its global business. This is a broad legal generalist role with a strong commercial focus, where you will work closely with the business and provide legal support across a wide range of matters, with particular emphasis on international contracts, tenders, customer projects and other commercial legal matters.

As Corporate Legal Counsel, you will become part of a small legal team together with Signe Karstoft, Legal Director, to whom you will report. The role is based at INVISIO’s headquarters in Hvidovre, and the legal function is organisationally anchored within INVISIO’s Sales & Program function, which consists of approximately 50 employees globally, including around 25-30 in Denmark. You will primarily support the global sales organisation and work closely with colleagues across the business. Much of your work will involve large and complex customer contracts, tenders and projects.

You will provide legal support across INVISIO’s international business, including in relation to US contracts, such as contracts within the defence sector, and support sales teams across Europe and other markets. You will also support INVISIO in connection with major public tenders, including tenders involving ministries and defence organisations, providing legal support on contractual and other legal questions arising throughout the tender process.

As a technology company, intellectual property is an important part of INVISIO’s business. While dedicated specialists handle areas such as patents, you may also advise on IP-related matters as part of the broader commercial legal support. Experience with IP or from a technology or other IP-intensive business would therefore be an advantage.

In addition to the day-to-day legal support, you will contribute to developing and improving the way Legal supports the business. This includes driving legal improvement initiatives, maintaining and developing contract templates and legal guidelines, and conducting workshops and awareness activities for the business.

The role is highly international and outward-facing, with significant interaction with customers and stakeholders at all levels. You will have opportunities to join customer visits and negotiate contracts abroad, as well as participate in trade fairs in Denmark, Europe and the US.

The role is expected to involve approximately 25 travel days per year.

As INVISIO continues to grow rapidly, you will work in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly, and no two days are the same.

INVISIO is looking for an independent and commercially minded lawyer who takes ownership and enjoys working closely with customers and colleagues across the organisation. Your key responsibilities will include:

Commercial contracts and negotiations:

• 
Draft, review and negotiate a broad range of commercial contracts, including large international sales contracts, non-disclosure agreements, letters of intent, consulting agreements, tender-related contracts and distribution agreements.

• 
Take an active role in customer dialogue and contract negotiations and provide commercially focused legal advice, working closely with relevant stakeholders to balance legal considerations with commercial objectives.

• 
Provide pragmatic legal advice on contractual and other commercial matters arising in the day-to-day business.

**

Tenders and customer projects:**

• 
Provide legal support in connection with major public tenders, including reviewing tender documentation and advising on contractual and other legal questions arising throughout the tender process.

• 
Advise on legal and contractual aspects of tender structures, including which INVISIO entity should participate and any related intercompany arrangements.

• 
Support and, where relevant, take a coordinating role in customer projects and other commercial initiatives, including advising on contractual set-ups, priorities and how existing solutions can be applied in different markets etc.

**

IP and export control:**

• Ad hoc Advise on IP and export control matters, including IP considerations in commercial agreements and questions relating to export restrictions and requirements in connection with international sales and customer projects.

**

Legal development and business support:**

• 
Develop, maintain and improve contract templates, legal guidelines and other tools.

• 
Drive legal improvement initiatives and conduct workshops and legal awareness activities for the business, for example in relation to NDA’s.

• 
Provide ad hoc legal advice and support across INVISIO as required.

REPORTING AND TITLE

Reporting to: Signe Karstoft, Legal Director.

Title: Corporate Legal Counsel.

IDEAL EXPERIENCE

Education: You hold a master’s degree in law (cand.jur. or cand.merc.jur.).

Work experience: You have approximately 3-6 years of relevant legal experience from an in-house role, for example in a technology or software company or another larger international industrial company.

Legal areas of specialisation: You have strong experience in drafting, reviewing and negotiating commercial agreements and are comfortable handling contractual matters independently. You also have experience supporting tender processes and advising on the legal and contractual matters that arise in this context.

In addition, you have a broad legal profile and are able to navigate a varied range of legal matters. Experience with IP-related matters, particularly from a technology or other IP-intensive business, would be an advantage. Knowledge of export control would also be beneficial.

Commercial: You have a strong commercial mindset and understand how legal advice fits into the broader business context.

You have experience working directly with customers and are comfortable collaborating with colleagues at all levels of the organisation. You are able to balance legal considerations with commercial objectives and provide pragmatic, solution-oriented advice.

Language skills: You are fluent in Danish and English, both written and verbal.

PERSONAL CAPABILITIES

Independent & proactive: You work independently, take ownership of your responsibilities and proactively drive matters forward.

Outgoing & interpersonal: You are outgoing and enjoy interacting with people with different backgrounds and at all levels, both internally and externally. You have strong interpersonal skills and are comfortable engaging with customers, colleagues and senior management.

Analytical & pragmatic: You have strong analytical skills and are able to understand complex legal and commercial matters while maintaining a pragmatic and solution-oriented approach.

Structured & able to prioritise: You work in a structured manner, maintain a good overview of your responsibilities and are able to prioritise effectively in a fast-paced environment where new and urgent matters frequently arise. You remain calm and focused when priorities change or deadlines are tight.

Stakeholder management & collaboration: You build strong relationships and collaborate effectively across functions and organisational levels. You are a team-oriented colleague who contributes to a strong sense of teamwork across the organisation and is able to influence stakeholders in a constructive manner.

Positive & constructive: You have a professional approach to your work and interact with others with maturity and integrity. You bring positive energy, are resilient when challenges arise and remain constructive in a busy environment.

INVISIO’S VALUE PROPOSITION TO YOU

INVISIO is a rapidly growing company with ambitious growth targets. The company achieves these ambitions through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. INVISIO offers a wide range of professional and social employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

ABOUT INVISIO

INVISIO is a global leader in communications technology for professionals working in mission-critical environments. Established in Denmark in 1999, the company develops and markets advanced, integrated communication systems for defence and public safety professionals, helping users communicate clearly and safely in demanding environments.

INVISIO’s modular and scalable portfolio includes headsets, control units, intercom systems, hubs and software designed to work together across dismounted, vehicle-based and command operations. The solutions are marketed under the INVISIO and Racal Acoustics brands.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, INVISIO has an international presence across Europe, North America and Asia. The company has approximately 330 employees globally, including around 215 in Denmark, and is growing rapidly. INVISIO is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm (Large Cap).

INVISIO is characterised by a strong focus on innovation, close customer collaboration and an international working environment. Its core values are Passion, Innovation, Teamwork and Customer First.

Job Description

Would you like to use your property management experience to help develop solutions that create real value? As a Property Manager at Netcompany, you will work with technical teams and customers to turn real-life experience into solutions that improve property management through a data driven approach that ensure the right usage of AI and digital capabilities.

Responsibilities

Netcompany is looking for a Property Manager to take a key role in the continued development of our property management solutions. The role is for an experienced, operational property manager who knows the reality of managing properties day to day and can use that experience to help shape better digital solutions. You will bring hands-on knowledge of property management into the product development process and work closely with technical and refinement teams to ensure that solutions reflect real-life processes, challenges and user needs. You will also contribute to customer dialogue, where your practical experience helps create credibility and a strong understanding of how the product can support customers in their daily work.

A significant part of the role involves leveraging your property management experience in product improvements, customer insight and relevant market activities. You will participate in customer meetings, support pre-sales activities and contribute to business development through market dialogue and feedback from existing and potential customers. This is not a sales role; your contribution is your professional expertise and ability to understand the customer's operational reality, ask the right questions and help connect their needs with the capabilities of the product.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Ensuring the product delivers value, automation potential and efficiency across the property management value chain

• Working closely with the technical team and refinement team on product development

• Supporting business development and sales activities through market dialogue, customer feedback and pre-sales activities

• Participating in customer meetings and other client-facing activities

• Building trust and credibility in customer dialogues

About you

To succeed in this role, you:

• Have solid operational experience working as a property manager

• Contribute with operational experience across a property portfolio, including the full complexity of Danish regulatory requirements (eg.  cost control rent 'OMK', free market rent, taxes, duties and rates, operational budgets)

• Have experience across residential, commercial and mixed properties including the customer reporting requirements a property manager faces

• Have experience as a power user or super user of a property management software system

• Have full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Partaking alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects.
